raw.buffDescription:
The Defender starts with a number of Vengeance charges equal to the Attacker’s Challenge Rating. The Defender loses a Vengeance charge every second. This timer is paused during either Champion’s Special Attacks or while a Striker is attacking. Each time a Striker is activated by the Attacker, the Defender gains 6 Vengeance charges. Effects that reduce the Ability Accuracy of all abilities cannot reduce the Defender's Abilities below 50% Ability Accuracy unless the Attacker has Class Advantage. 

While the Defender has half of their starting Vengeance Charges or less, they gain +200% Attack Rating, effects that reduce the Ability Accuracy of all abilities cannot reduce the Defender's Ability Accuracy unless the Attacker has Class Advantage, and the Attacker is Passively Rooted during the Defender’s Special Attacks. 

While the Defender has 0 Vengeance Charges, they are Stun Immune, Immune to all forms of Power manipulation, Passively Unblockable, and they gain 15% of a Bar of Power every second while the Attacker is not within striking distance.
